task.title: P6-078: Fix three kill-verified collection-view test-strength leftovers
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 9 — Dev loop, tests and test strength). Original id: P6-078. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/ui-work-loop.md.

**Collection-view test-strength leftovers, all kill-verified** (all three still standing 2026-07-30): (a) the `here_delta` reset's `is_some()` guard is **inert** — removing it survives the whole spec — and the comment justifying it is factually wrong about Leptos 0.8 (`collection.rs:205-221`, unchanged since `7ece00f`; `ArcAsyncDerived` never clears `value` on re-run, and `<Transition>` renders nothing during a refetch rather than the stale payload); correct the comment and either test the guard or drop it; (b) the deck `color-identity` badge is asserted against `/commanders` → `commanders_in` → `union_color_identity` (`hosted.rs:2434-2458`, `tags.rs:130`) — the same helper that produced the badge — so reversing WUBRG order survives the e2e and only `cargo test -p shared` kills it; (c) the "three columns agree" test flaked 1-in-3 full-tier runs because the write tests (`stepper`, `floor`, `teardown` at `:927`, `:1005`, `:1050`) all seed from `somePrinting()` = Trade Binder's first card, oscillating the global `owned` that the read at `:239` observes — point the write tests at a Depth-Box printing.
